mapper.insert: INSERT INTO aup_audit_log (aup_id, actor, role, action, from_stage, to_stage, comment, created_at) VALUES (#{aupId}, #{actor}, #{role}, #{action}, #{fromStage}, #{toStage}, #{comment}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM aup_audit_log WHERE aup_id = #{aupId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
